findings.suggested_fix: Update DHTS-2026-10-12.tex to reflect the unified sample: change 55,350,482 to 55,343,368 (line 399), 51,066,203 to 51,036,859 (lines 401, 484), 14,427,780 to 14,416,543 (line 404), and 28.3% to 28.2% (lines 97, 180, 404, 449); delete or revise the obsolete text at lines 402 and 544 that explains the eliminated 29,344-record gap.
findings.title: Unification of balance sample to linkage analysis sample in commit ca680d4 leaves manuscript prose, counts, and notes contradicting the generated tables
findings.what_the_code_does: In commit ca680d4, CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:98-100 was altered to merge with enum_date/DATA/INTERMEDIATE/temp.dta using assert(master match), switching Tables 2 and 3 from the legacy 51,066,203 sample to the 51,036,859 linkage analysis sample (with 14,416,543 incongruent records, 28.247% incongruence, and 55,343,368 US males 10+). However, DHTS-2026-10-12.tex was not updated. The paper still reports 55,350,482 males 10+ (line 399), 51,066,203 in the analysis sample (line 401), 14,427,780 incongruent records and 28.3% disagreement (lines 97, 180, 404, 449), prints a table note in Table 3 citing 51,066,203 directly beneath a table showing 51,036,859 (line 484), and retains an obsolete paragraph in Table 4's note explaining a 29,344-record (0.06%) sample difference between Table 2 and Table 4 that the code has now eliminated.
findings.why_it_matters: Multiple headline sample numbers in the text now directly conflict with the tables embedded in the same document. A referee will immediately see that Table 2 and Table 3 report 51,036,859 while the prose quotes 51,066,203, that Table 3's note gives a sample size different from the table's observation count, and that Table 4 explains a discrepancy that does not exist in the exhibits.

findings.how_to_check: Review replication/run_machineA.do:39-49 to confirm merged_*1940.dta is absent from local inputs. In CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:75, note the absence of an assertion on z.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the 50 merged_`state'1940.dta files to the preflight inputs loop in replication/run_machineA.do, and add an explicit 'assert `z' == 50' (or 49) in CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do after line 75.
findings.title: Rebuilt make_balance_exhibits.do dynamically globs state files without an expected-count assertion, and run_machineA.do omits them from preflight
findings.what_the_code_does: In CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:64-75, state files are loaded using 'local files : dir "`trans_intermediate_f'" files "merged_*1940.dta"'. The loop increments z and displays 'state files read: `z'', but never asserts that z equals the expected 50 (or 49) jurisdictions. Furthermore, in replication/run_machineA.do:39-49, while the superseded F:/.../temp.dta was removed from the preflight list, the 50 merged_*1940.dta input files were not added to the preflight check.
findings.why_it_matters: If any state file is missing on a replication run, run_machineA.do will pass preflight without warning, and make_balance_exhibits.do will silently construct an incomplete 1940 census sample and overwrite balance_allstates.tex without erroring. Conversely, if no state files exist, preflight passes but make_balance_exhibits.do fails hours into the batch run.

findings.title: Hardcoded drive letters and paths re-introduced in make_balance_exhibits.do bypass replication configuration
findings.what_the_code_does: Lines 57-60 of CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do set local paths with hardcoded Windows drive letters ('F:/fixing_transcription_errors/DATA/INTERMEDIATE/', 'F:\enum_date\DATA\ORIGINAL\', 'D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors\CODE\') instead of referencing the globals defined in replication/config.do ($REP_F, $REP_SNU, $REP_REPO).
findings.why_it_matters: Breaks standalone portability for external replicators whose data directory is mapped to a different drive letter or mount point, undermining the centralization established in replication/config.do.

summary: Commit range 8f77943..ca680d4 unifies the balance tables and linkage exhibits onto a single analysis sample (51,036,859 records) and provides diagnostic scripts sizing pipeline merges and sample discrepancies. However, the commit modified the generated LaTeX exhibits without updating the manuscript draft (DHTS-2026-10-12.tex), leaving text counts, percentages, and table notes in direct contradiction with the newly generated tables. The single most important fix is to update the manuscript counts and remove obsolete text explaining the now-eliminated 29,344-record sample gap.
